title: sinTerm: the k-th term of the sin(1) alternating series
statement: CReal.sinTerm k := (-1)^k * expTerm(2k+1), where expTerm j = 1/j! (as a CReal). This is the k-th term of the Taylor series for sin(1) = sum (-1)^k/(2k+1)!, the odd-index analogue of CReal.cosTerm's even-index terms. A total, axiom-free definition.
